turns.text: For Sunday I would rather keep the morning unplanned and decide once we see the weather.
I need one concrete thing decided now: whether I bring the climbing gear.
Those can coexist. We can keep the destination open but decide on the gear from the forecast threshold.
What forecast would make bringing it worthwhile?
If the chance of rain stays under twenty percent, bring it; otherwise we leave it. The gear question is settled—what other ways could we leave the rest of the morning open?
